description: A company's page fit plus the distribution of its people's geometric means (median, baseline band), top people and who is under the 18-post floor. Company typical post = median over up to 5 counted fitted people plus the company page: founders, CEO and C-suite who posted in the last 90 days first, then the most active fitted people (by original posts in that window). With exactly one fitted account (a person or the page) the company ranks on that account's own fit, flagged "1 account"; it is held back while teammates still await their history pull. people.counted / countedPersonIds say who is in. Use for 'how is X doing on LinkedIn'.

company.description: Company name or dashboard slug, if no id.
